questions.question: When David cried out "How long, O LORD?" in his sorrow, what did he ask God about himself?

answers.text: Whether God will forget him forever
Whether God will send rain soon
Whether God will make him rich

questions.question: In his prayer for help, David said his foes would mourn for him when he fell. True or false?
After asking God "how long" over and over, what did David say he had trusted in?
David said he would sing to the LORD. What reason did he give?

answers.text: The LORD has been good to him
His enemy has finally run off
